column2: [intro]
I'm a mess, a bit obsessed,
Everything’s mixed up, I'm disorganized at best.
Socks here, keys over there,
A real jumble, but that’s how I fare.
I’m a mess, that’s what defines me,
In this disorder, I find harmony.
Among stacks of papers and old newspapers,
I live my life in this joyful chaos.
I’m a perfectionist, that’s true too,
I want everything perfect, everything through.
Colors harmonize, shapes align,
Even if it’s sometimes a hard climb.
I’m a perfectionist, to the extreme,
I want everything flawless, it’s my theme.
In my perfect world, everything’s in place,
Even if it might be a bit of a chase.
[ solo ]
I’m a mess and a perfectionist, yeah,
A true phenomenon, a puzzle, what do I do with that?
But it’s my personality, what makes me unique,
So I embrace it and cultivate this quirky streak.
[outro]
